summary: Hardened custom run input aliases and raw download transfers: --set has its own backing storage and output downloads go through the client rate limiter on a streaming client.
reason: The hand-authored run surface needed separate --set backing storage, and custom download requests must honor client rate limiting and must not be cut off by the JSON-sized --timeout. Uploads now go through the generated client (x-pp-replay-safe), so the raw upload path from the prior record is gone.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passed after the publish-review fixes, including mixed --set/--input-kv and echoed-input URL filtering.
